issues.rationale: A delayed old-window call could overwrite a newer fixed window and reset its counter.
issues.fix: Only advance the window when the candidate is newer and keep stale calls on the current window.
issues.disposition_reason: The upsert now compares windows with a strict greater-than condition; PostgreSQL regression tests prove a stale call cannot roll the current window back.

issues.rationale: Unsupported methods and framework-provided HEAD or OPTIONS behavior could bypass the shared authentication, rate-limit, and logging guard.
issues.fix: Export explicit guarded handlers for HEAD and every unsupported method on all external API routes.
issues.disposition_reason: All four routes now send HEAD through guarded GET and DELETE, OPTIONS, PATCH, POST, and PUT through a guarded 405 response; route and production-build checks passed.

issues.rationale: Awaiting the best-effort access-log query without a deadline could delay every API response indefinitely.
issues.fix: Bound the logging wait and preserve the original API response on timeout.
issues.disposition_reason: Access-log waiting is capped at 250ms with a regression test for a never-resolving query.

issues.rationale: Organization lookup, last-used updates, unbounded counter updates, and one log row per denied request amplified database writes after the limit was exceeded.
issues.fix: Reject before organization loading, saturate the counter, and aggregate 429 logs per key, endpoint, and window.
issues.disposition_reason: The counter saturates at 61, 429 returns before organization and last-used operations, and a unique window key aggregates denied logs.

issues.rationale: The ledger still described PR creation as the next task even though PR 19 and Round 1 review already existed.
issues.fix: Record the active PR, review baseline, dispositions, validation, and next review round.
issues.disposition_reason: The latest ledger entry now records PR 19, the Noether baseline, all Round 1 fixes, completed validation, and the Round 2 transition.

issues.rationale: The database test sampled only a subset of anon and authenticated table, sequence, and RPC privileges.
issues.fix: Exercise the complete role and operation matrix for both server-only tables, the identity sequence, and the RPC.
issues.disposition_reason: The PostgreSQL test now checks SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE for both roles and tables plus sequence and RPC privileges.
